image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer stands at left beside a simple desk and points to a large desktop monitor at center. On its otherwise blank screen show exactly one large WHITE outlined generic folder icon with a clear raised tab at upper left, no contents and no writing. Keep the folder icon large, complete and unobstructed for cropping. The white OpenAI knot floats to the right outside the monitor. No other icons, arrows, laptop or objects.

coverage_review.scope: V012 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/V012.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅黑底白线，一个火柴人和一个可辨认的 OpenAI 六环结标识，无底图对白文字。屏幕中的文件夹图标完整、无文字，只框图标而非整个显示器，不宣称已读取实际目录。
